roadmaps.title: Frontend Developer
roadmaps.description: Master modern client-side engineering: semantic web standards, modern JavaScript/TypeScript, reactive frameworks (React/Next.js), performance profiling, and state management.
prerequisites: Understanding of web browsers and HTTP basics

stages.title: Stage 1: Web Fundamentals & Semantics
stages.summary: Build rock-solid foundations in semantic HTML5 markup, responsive CSS3 layouts (Flexbox & CSS Grid), and version control with Git.
topics: Semantic HTML5 elements, forms, and input validation
CSS Box Model, Flexbox & CSS Grid layouts
Responsive Web Design, Media Queries, and Mobile-First strategy
Git version control: branching, merge conflicts, and GitHub workflows
Web accessibility (a11y) basics: WCAG 2.1, ARIA roles, and keyboard navigation
stages.project: Build an accessible, responsive personal portfolio & project showcase with dark/light theme toggle.

stages.title: Stage 2: JavaScript Mastery & Modern ES6+
stages.summary: Deep-dive into JavaScript execution context, event loop, closures, async programming, and DOM manipulation.
topics: Scope, Closures, Hoisting, and Prototypes
DOM manipulation, event delegation, and bubbling
Asynchronous JavaScript: Promises, Async/Await, and Fetch API
ES6+ features: destructuring, modules, map/set, rest/spread
Package management with npm, pnpm, and modern bundlers (Vite)
stages.project: Develop an interactive multi-filter dashboard with live search, local storage caching, and API pagination.

stages.title: Stage 3: TypeScript & Component Frameworks (React / Next.js)
stages.summary: Learn static typing with TypeScript and build complex single-page / server-rendered applications with React & Next.js.
topics: TypeScript fundamentals: interfaces, generics, utility types, and strict mode
React Core: JSX, components, props, hooks (useState, useEffect, useMemo, useCallback)
State management strategies: Zustand, Redux Toolkit, and TanStack Query
Next.js App Router: Server Components (RSC), dynamic routes, metadata, and SSR/SSG
Styling with Tailwind CSS, CSS Modules, and Shadcn UI / Headless UI
stages.project: Build a production-ready SaaS dashboard featuring authentication, real-time data filtering, and server-side rendering.

stages.title: Stage 4: Testing, Performance & Core Web Vitals
stages.summary: Test applications thoroughly, optimize load times, and master Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS).
topics: Unit and integration testing with Vitest and React Testing Library
End-to-end (E2E) testing with Playwright or Cypress
Core Web Vitals profiling: Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), Interaction to Next Paint (INP)
Code-splitting, lazy loading, image optimization, and bundle analysis
CI/CD automated testing pipelines via GitHub Actions
stages.project: Audit and optimize an existing web app to score 95+ on Lighthouse Performance, Accessibility, and SEO.

stages.title: Stage 5: Architecture, Microfrontends & System Scale
stages.summary: Scale frontend architectures across enterprise teams: design systems, microfrontends, internationalization, and offline-first PWAs.
topics: Building enterprise design systems with Storybook and tokenized themes
Microfrontend architecture (Module Federation, iframe sandboxing)
Progressive Web Apps (PWAs), service workers, and IndexedDB offline caching
Security best practices: CSP headers, XSS prevention, and CSRF tokens
WebSockets and real-time collaborative state synchronization
stages.project: Create an open-source, accessible Design System component library published to npm with automated Storybook documentation.

roadmaps.title: Backend Developer
roadmaps.description: Engineer resilient server-side systems: scalable microservices, relational and NoSQL databases, caching layers, distributed event streaming, and secure REST/gRPC APIs.
prerequisites: Basic programming concepts (variables, loops, data structures)
certifications: Oracle Certified Professional Java SE Developer

stages.title: Stage 1: Programming Language & Core Paradigms
stages.summary: Master a robust backend language (Node.js, Go, or Python) along with data structures, algorithms, and I/O concurrency.
topics: Data structures: hash maps, trees, queues, linked lists, and time complexity (Big-O)
OOP and Functional programming paradigms, dependency injection, and clean architecture
Concurrency models: event loop, goroutines, threads, async I/O
Standard library networking, file system I/O, and environment configurations
Unit testing with mocking and test-driven development (TDD)
stages.project: Build a high-performance multithreaded CLI tool with concurrent file processing and benchmark metrics.

stages.title: Stage 2: Relational Databases & Schema Design
stages.summary: Master PostgreSQL, relational schema design, query optimization, indexing, and transactional isolation.
topics: SQL mastery: complex joins, window functions, CTEs, and aggregation
Database normalization (1NF-3NF) vs denormalization tradeoffs
ACID properties and transaction isolation levels (Read Committed, Serializable)
B-tree, GIN, and GiST indexing strategies; EXPLAIN ANALYZE query planning
Schema migrations, connection pooling (PgBouncer), and ORM tradeoffs (Prisma/Drizzle/GORM)
stages.project: Design an e-commerce transactional database with inventory reservation locks, audit logging, and sub-10ms query execution.

stages.title: Stage 3: API Design, Authentication & Security
stages.summary: Architect secure, documented, and versioned APIs using RESTful standards, GraphQL, and gRPC.
topics: RESTful design principles, HTTP verbs, status codes, and idempotency
Authentication protocols: OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWTs, and refresh token rotation
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC)
API documentation with OpenAPI / Swagger contracts
Rate limiting, CORS, input sanitization, and OWASP API Top 10 defenses
stages.project: Build an enterprise Auth & User Management microservice with OAuth2 social login, session invalidation, and rate limiting.

stages.title: Stage 4: Caching, Message Queues & Distributed Systems
stages.summary: Scale backend throughput using in-memory caches, message brokers, and asynchronous event workers.
topics: In-memory caching patterns with Redis: Cache-Aside, Write-Through, TTL invalidation
Message brokers: RabbitMQ, Apache Kafka, and AWS SQS
Event-driven architecture: pub/sub, consumer groups, idempotency, and dead-letter queues (DLQ)
Distributed locks (Redlock) and idempotency keys for distributed transactions
Background worker queues (BullMQ, Celery) for intensive computing jobs
stages.project: Implement an asynchronous order processing pipeline with Kafka event streaming, Redis caching, and email dispatch workers.

stages.title: Stage 5: Microservices, Observability & Cloud Deployment
stages.summary: Package, deploy, monitor, and scale distributed backend microservices on cloud infrastructure.
topics: Microservices decomp: domain-driven design (DDD) and bounded contexts
gRPC and Protocol Buffers for ultra-fast internal service communication
Containerization with Docker and Kubernetes deployment manifests
Observability: distributed tracing with OpenTelemetry, Prometheus metrics, and structured logging
CI/CD zero-downtime rolling and blue-green deployments
stages.project: Architect and deploy a containerized multi-service platform with gRPC internal communication and Grafana observability.

roadmaps.title: Full Stack Developer
roadmaps.description: Unify frontend elegance with robust backend engineering. Build complete end-to-end applications from database schema to responsive user interface and cloud deployment.
prerequisites: Basic HTML, CSS, and general programming interest

stages.title: Stage 1: Frontend Foundations & Responsive UI
stages.summary: Master responsive web markup, modern CSS styling frameworks, and client-side JavaScript.
topics: Semantic HTML5, CSS3, Flexbox, and CSS Grid layout systems
Tailwind CSS for rapid, maintainable component design
Modern JavaScript (ES6+), DOM manipulation, and asynchronous Fetch requests
Git version control and collaborative GitHub workflows
stages.project: Build an interactive product catalog with client-side filtering, sorting, and responsive mobile layout.

stages.title: Stage 2: Full-Stack React & Server Frameworks
stages.summary: Build interactive component-driven interfaces using React and full-stack frameworks like Next.js.
topics: React functional components, hooks, and virtual DOM reconciliation
TypeScript across the entire stack for end-to-end type safety
Next.js App Router: Server Components, Server Actions, and API routes
State management with Zustand and client-server sync with TanStack Query
stages.project: Create a collaborative task management application with drag-and-drop boards and real-time updates.

stages.title: Stage 3: Database Modeling & Server-Side APIs
stages.summary: Model data in PostgreSQL, integrate modern ORMs, and secure backend endpoints.
topics: PostgreSQL database design, relationships (1:1, 1:N, N:M), and indexing
Type-safe database ORMs: Prisma, Drizzle, or Supabase
User authentication, session cookies, and JWT token management
File storage uploads (AWS S3, Cloudinary) and image optimization
stages.project: Build an e-commerce platform with stripe checkout, user order history, and product image uploads.

stages.title: Stage 4: Real-Time Sync, Caching & Performance
stages.summary: Add real-time capabilities via WebSockets, cache intensive queries with Redis, and optimize Core Web Vitals.
topics: Real-time bidirectional communication using WebSockets (Socket.io) or SSE
In-memory caching and session store management with Redis
Web vital optimizations: server-side rendering, code-splitting, and memoization
Automated testing with Vitest and Playwright
stages.project: Develop a real-time collaborative document editor with cursor tracking and instant chat.

stages.title: Stage 5: DevOps, Docker & Production Cloud Deployment
stages.summary: Containerize applications, set up CI/CD automation, and deploy to serverless or cloud container platforms.
topics: Dockerizing full-stack applications with multi-stage production Dockerfiles
Setting up automated CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions
Deploying on Vercel, Render, AWS ECS, or Fly.io with custom domains and SSL
Database backups, disaster recovery, and production error monitoring (Sentry)
stages.project: Deploy your full-stack SaaS platform to production with custom domain, automated CI/CD, and error tracking.

roadmaps.title: AI & LLM Engineer
roadmaps.description: Architect frontier generative AI systems, production RAG pipelines, fine-tuned domain models, vector databases, and autonomous multi-agent reasoning workflows.
prerequisites: Basic linear algebra, probability, and matrix operations

stages.title: Stage 1: Python, Math & Core ML Foundations
stages.summary: Solidify Python mastery for AI, linear algebra matrix operations, probability, and PyTorch tensor mechanics.
topics: Python async programming, typing, and high-performance NumPy arrays
Linear algebra: vector dot products, cosine similarity, matrix multiplications
Calculus & optimization: gradients, backpropagation, and loss functions
PyTorch basics: Tensors, autograd, Dataset/DataLoader pipelines, and GPU acceleration
Traditional machine learning baselines (Scikit-Learn) and evaluation metrics (F1, Precision, Recall)
stages.project: Build and train a custom neural network in PyTorch from scratch to classify multi-class text documents.

stages.title: Stage 2: Transformer Architecture & Hugging Face
stages.summary: Master the Transformer architecture: self-attention, positional encoding, and Hugging Face ecosystem.
topics: Attention mechanisms: Scaled Dot-Product, Multi-Head Attention, and FlashAttention
Encoder-only (BERT), Decoder-only (GPT/Llama), and Encoder-Decoder (T5) paradigms
Tokenization strategies: BPE, WordPiece, SentencePiece, and token limits
Hugging Face Transformers, Datasets, and Accelerate libraries
Quantization fundamentals: bitsandbytes, AWQ, GGUF, and memory footprint calculations
stages.project: Implement a mini-Transformer from scratch in PyTorch capable of generative character-level text completion.

stages.title: Stage 3: Enterprise RAG & Vector Databases
stages.summary: Architect enterprise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines with vector embeddings and hybrid search.
topics: Dense vector embeddings (OpenAI, BGE, Cohere) and semantic search
Vector databases: Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, and pgvector
Advanced chunking strategies: semantic chunking, recursive splitters, and metadata preservation
Hybrid search (BM25 sparse + dense vector) and cross-encoder reranking (Cohere Rerank)
Evaluating RAG systems with RAGAS (faithfulness, answer relevancy, context precision)
stages.project: Build an enterprise document search engine with hybrid retrieval, cross-encoder reranking, and source citations.

stages.title: Stage 4: Autonomous Agents & Function Calling
stages.summary: Develop autonomous multi-agent reasoning workflows, tool execution, and stateful memory loops.
topics: ReAct (Reason + Act) prompting pattern and structured JSON tool calling
Multi-agent frameworks: LangGraph, CrewAI, and AutoGen
Long-term and short-term agent memory: session histories, vector summaries
Human-in-the-loop (HITL) approval workflows and safety guardrails (NeMo Guardrails)
Handling latency, streaming token outputs, and fallback retry strategies
stages.project: Create an autonomous financial research agent team that crawls live stock data, synthesizes SEC filings, and drafts investor reports.

stages.title: Stage 5: Model Fine-Tuning & High-Throughput Serving
stages.summary: Fine-tune open-weights models and deploy ultra-low-latency serving infrastructure in production.
topics: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT): LoRA, QLoRA, and DoRA
Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) and RLHF alignment workflows
High-throughput inference serving with vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, and TGI
Continuous batching, PagedAttention, and KV-cache memory optimization
LLMOps: monitoring latency, hallucinations, token costs, and prompt injection attacks
stages.project: Fine-tune a Llama-3 model using QLoRA on domain data, and deploy it to a production vLLM cluster with 100+ concurrent requests.

roadmaps.title: DevOps & Cloud Engineer
roadmaps.description: Build robust infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes container orchestration, Infrastructure as Code, and enterprise site reliability.

stages.title: Stage 1: Linux Systems, Networking & Scripting
stages.summary: Master Linux system administration, core networking protocols, and automation scripting.
topics: Linux file hierarchy, permissions, process management, and systemd units
Networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, UDP, DNS, TLS/SSL, HTTP/2, and iptables
Bash shell scripting: pipes, redirects, regex, and cron automation
Python/Go for infrastructure automation scripts and API interactions
SSH key security, bastions, and zero-trust remote access
stages.project: Author automated Linux server provisioning and security-hardening scripts with automated backup validation.

stages.title: Stage 2: Containerization with Docker
stages.summary: Containerize microservices, optimize image sizes, and establish secure local orchestration.
topics: Container internals: namespaces, cgroups, and layered union filesystems
Writing minimal, production-grade multi-stage Dockerfiles
Docker Compose for multi-container local development environments
Container vulnerability scanning (Trivy, Docker Scout)
Container networking, bridge networks, and volume persistence
stages.project: Containerize a complete multi-tier application (React frontend, Node API, Redis, PostgreSQL) with minimal Alpine images.

stages.title: Stage 3: Kubernetes Orchestration & Helm
stages.summary: Deploy and manage resilient production workloads on Kubernetes clusters.
topics: Kubernetes core architecture: API Server, etcd, Kubelet, Scheduler
Workload primitives: Pods, Deployments, StatefulSets, DaemonSets, Jobs
Networking: Services (ClusterIP, NodePort, LoadBalancer) and Ingress controllers
ConfigMaps, Secrets, PersistentVolumes, and StorageClasses
Packaging and versioning applications with Helm charts
stages.project: Deploy a high-availability microservice cluster with autoscaling (HPA), rolling updates, and custom Helm templates.

stages.title: Stage 4: Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) & Cloud
stages.summary: Provision repeatable cloud infrastructure across AWS or Google Cloud using Terraform.
topics: Terraform core: providers, resources, variables, outputs, and remote state locks (S3 + DynamoDB)
Modular Terraform design, workspaces, and DRY principles
Cloud fundamentals: VPCs, subnets, route tables, internet gateways, and security groups
IAM policies, roles, least-privilege principles, and cloud KMS encryption
Managed Kubernetes (AWS EKS or GCP GKE) provisioning
stages.project: Provision a multi-AZ VPC, managed EKS/GKE cluster, and secure RDS database entirely using reusable Terraform modules.

stages.title: Stage 5: CI/CD, GitOps & SRE Observability
stages.summary: Automate delivery pipelines with GitOps and monitor system reliability with Prometheus and Grafana.
topics: CI/CD automation with GitHub Actions: build matrix, caching, automated testing
GitOps continuous deployment using ArgoCD or Flux
Observability trifecta: Metrics (Prometheus), Logs (Loki), Traces (Jaeger/OpenTelemetry)
Creating alerting rules (Alertmanager) and Grafana operational dashboards
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices: SLOs, error budgets, and post-mortems
stages.project: Build a GitOps continuous deployment pipeline with ArgoCD that deploys changes automatically upon merge and triggers Grafana alerts.

roadmaps.title: Cybersecurity & Ethical Hacking
roadmaps.description: Defend enterprise perimeters, conduct professional penetration tests, audit cloud systems, and implement zero-trust security postures.

stages.title: Stage 1: Networking Protocols & Security Baselines
stages.summary: Master network architecture, packets, encryption primitives, and OS security controls.
topics: OSI model, packet inspection, and protocol analysis with Wireshark
Cryptography: symmetric (AES), asymmetric (RSA, ECC), hashing (SHA-256), and PKI
Linux and Windows security baselines (CIS Benchmarks)
Network perimeters: firewalls, DMZs, proxies, and VPN tunnels
stages.project: Conduct a comprehensive network packet audit and configure an enterprise firewall with intrusion detection.

stages.title: Stage 2: Web Application Penetration Testing
stages.summary: Discover and exploit web vulnerabilities following the OWASP Top 10 methodology.
topics: OWASP Top 10: SQL injection, Cross-Site Scripting (XSS), CSRF, SSRF, IDOR
Web intercepting proxies: Burp Suite Professional and OWASP ZAP
Authentication bypasses, session hijacking, and JWT tampering
Automated vulnerability scanning and manual exploit verification
stages.project: Complete vulnerable lab challenges (PortSwigger Web Security Academy) and write a professional penetration test report.

stages.title: Stage 3: Defensive Security (SOC & Incident Response)
stages.summary: Monitor live threat telemetry, detect attacks with SIEM solutions, and execute incident containment.
topics: Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) with Splunk or Elastic Security
Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) and Sysmon telemetry
MITRE ATT&CK framework mapping for threat actor behavior
Incident response phases: containment, eradication, recovery, and forensics
stages.project: Set up a virtual SOC lab, simulate malware execution, and correlate SIEM alerts to trace the attack timeline.

stages.title: Stage 4: Cloud Security & DevSecOps
stages.summary: Secure cloud architectures (AWS/GCP), container registries, and automated CI/CD pipelines.
topics: Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and Cloud Workload Protection (CWPP)
IAM least privilege, role assumption, and cross-account boundaries
Container security: image scanning, Docker rootless mode, and Kubernetes admission controllers
Static and Dynamic code analysis (SAST/DAST) in CI/CD pipelines
stages.project: Audit a multi-account cloud environment for misconfigurations and implement automated policy-as-code remediation.

stages.title: Stage 5: Enterprise Governance & Red Teaming
stages.summary: Execute advanced red-team tradecraft, physical/social engineering, and regulatory governance (SOC2, ISO 27001).
topics: Active Directory attacks: Kerberoasting, Pass-the-Hash, BloodHound graph analysis
Privilege escalation on Linux and Windows endpoints
Security compliance frameworks: ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF, and GDPR
Executive risk reporting and security policy formulation
stages.project: Conduct an end-to-end simulated active directory penetration test and present remediation findings to an executive board.

roadmaps.title: Embedded Systems & Firmware Engineer
roadmaps.description: Develop low-level bare-metal and RTOS firmware, hardware drivers, communication protocols (CAN/SPI/I2C), and IoT edge sensor networks on ARM Cortex and RISC-V microcontrollers.

stages.title: Stage 1: Embedded C, Memory & Computer Architecture
stages.summary: Master pointer arithmetic, memory layouts, bitwise register manipulation, and low-level computer architecture.
topics: C for embedded: pointers, volatile qualifiers, structs, memory alignment, and bitwise masks
Microcontroller memory map: Flash, SRAM, stack, heap, and register spaces
Assembly language basics and compiler toolchain (GNU Arm Embedded Toolchain)
Reading hardware schematics, pinouts, and microcontroller datasheets
stages.project: Write bare-metal startup code, linker script, and GPIO driver without any external vendor libraries.

stages.title: Stage 2: Microcontroller Peripherals & Hardware Buses
stages.summary: Interface hardware peripherals using UART, SPI, I2C, Timers, ADC/DAC, and DMA channels.
topics: Hardware communication protocols: UART, SPI, I2C, and CAN bus
Interrupt Service Routines (ISRs), NVIC priority grouping, and latency
Direct Memory Access (DMA) for zero-CPU peripheral transfers
Hardware debugging using JTAG / SWD probes and logic analyzers
stages.project: Build an I2C sensor logging system with DMA circular buffering, SPI OLED display output, and UART telemetry.

stages.title: Stage 3: Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS)
stages.summary: Implement multitasking, task prioritization, synchronization, and memory safety using FreeRTOS or Zephyr RTOS.
topics: RTOS kernel fundamentals: task states, preemption, tick interrupts, and context switching
Inter-task communication: queues, semaphores, mutexes, and event flags
Preventing race conditions, priority inversion (priority inheritance), and deadlocks
Memory management: heap allocation schemes and stack overflow detection
stages.project: Develop an RTOS-based telemetry node with multi-priority tasks for sensor acquisition, filtering, and wireless dispatch.

stages.title: Stage 4: Wireless IoT & Low-Power Optimization
stages.summary: Build connected edge devices with BLE, Wi-Fi, LoRaWAN, and implement microamp-level sleep modes.
topics: Wireless communication: Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE GATT services), Wi-Fi, LoRaWAN
Ultra-low-power sleep modes (Stop, Standby) and RTC wake-up triggers
Battery lifecycle profiling and dynamic power dissipation reduction
Secure bootloaders and Over-The-Air (OTA) firmware update verification
stages.project: Design a battery-operated environmental sensor device that wakes up, transmits encrypted telemetry over BLE, and sleeps under 5µA.

stages.title: Stage 5: Edge AI (TinyML) & Production Firmware
stages.summary: Run machine learning models on microcontrollers and harden firmware for industrial reliability.
topics: Deploying quantized TinyML models (TensorFlow Lite for Microcontrollers)
Automated Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) testing and continuous integration for firmware
Static analysis (MISRA C compliance) and defensive programming
Device fleet management, factory provisioning, and root of trust
stages.project: Deploy an onboard audio anomaly detection model on an ARM Cortex-M4 microcontroller running continuous real-time classification.

roadmaps.title: VLSI Physical Design & ASIC Engineer
roadmaps.description: Transform RTL netlists into high-yield physical silicon chips. Master synthesis, floorplanning, placement and routing (P&R), static timing analysis (STA), and DRC/LVS closure on advanced semiconductor nodes.

stages.title: Stage 1: Digital Logic & Hardware Description Languages
stages.summary: Master combinational and sequential digital circuits, FSMs, and RTL synthesis in Verilog.
topics: Boolean algebra, Karnaugh maps, CMOS logic gates, and setup/hold time concepts
Verilog / SystemVerilog RTL coding for synthesizable hardware logic
Finite State Machine (FSM) architectures (Moore and Mealy machines)
Simulation testbenches, assertions, and functional waveform verification
stages.project: Design, simulate, and verify a pipelined 32-bit RISC-V integer execution core with branch prediction.

stages.title: Stage 2: Logic Synthesis & SDC Timing Constraints
stages.summary: Convert RTL code into gate-level netlists and formulate Synopsys Design Constraints (SDC).
topics: Logic synthesis workflows and standard cell library characterization (.lib)
Authoring Synopsys Design Constraints (SDC): clocks, input/output delays, multicycle paths
Power, Performance, and Area (PPA) optimization tradeoffs during synthesis
Clock gating insertion and dynamic power optimization
stages.project: Synthesize a multi-module cryptographic accelerator and generate optimized gate-level netlists across speed and area.

stages.title: Stage 3: Floorplanning & Power Grid Synthesis
stages.summary: Establish die boundaries, macro placement, I/O pin assignments, and robust power distribution networks.
topics: Die aspect ratios, core utilization, and pin placement guidelines
Macro placement strategies and routing channel spacing
Power distribution network (PDN) design: power rings, stripes, and IR drop prevention
Decoupling capacitor (decap) cell insertion and electro-static discharge (ESD) protection
stages.project: Design a complete chip floorplan with distributed power mesh and zero IR drop violations across all operation modes.

stages.title: Stage 4: Placement, Clock Tree Synthesis (CTS) & Routing
stages.summary: Execute standard cell placement, build low-skew clock trees, and route signal interconnects.
topics: Global and detailed standard cell placement algorithms
Clock Tree Synthesis (CTS): buffer tree insertion, clock skew, and insertion delay minimization
Global and detailed routing: antenna rules, crosstalk avoidance, and shielding
Fixing setup and hold violations dynamically during post-routing optimization
stages.project: Perform complete P&R on a high-speed SoC subsystem, closing clock skew within 50ps at 500MHz.

stages.title: Stage 5: Static Timing Analysis (STA) & Physical Verification
stages.summary: Validate timing closure across all PVT corners and achieve DRC/LVS tape-out cleanliness.
topics: Static Timing Analysis (STA) across multi-mode multi-corner (MMMC) operating conditions
Design Rule Check (DRC) and Layout Versus Schematic (LVS) verification using Mentor Calibre
Electromigration (EM) and signal integrity (SI) noise glitch analysis
Tape-out GDSII / OASIS generation and foundry hand-off protocols
stages.project: Achieve complete zero-DRC, zero-LVS, and timing-closed GDSII tape-out sign-off for a real silicon fabrication run.

roadmaps.title: Product Manager (Tech & AI)
roadmaps.description: Own the end-to-end product lifecycle: user discovery, PRDs, feature prioritization, agile execution, data analytics, and go-to-market commercialization.

stages.title: Stage 1: Customer Discovery & Problem Definition
stages.summary: Uncover real customer pain points through structured qualitative interviews and market research.
topics: Conducting user interviews without bias (The Mom Test framework)
Developing buyer personas, empathy maps, and jobs-to-be-done (JTBD)
Competitive landscape analysis and unique value proposition mapping
Defining problem statements and opportunity solution trees
stages.project: Conduct 10 user interviews in a chosen industry, synthesize pain points, and author an Opportunity Assessment Document.

stages.title: Stage 2: Product Strategy, PRDs & Roadmapping
stages.summary: Define product vision, author detailed Product Requirement Documents, and manage roadmap priorities.
topics: Writing crisp PRDs: user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and success metrics
Feature prioritization frameworks: RICE, Kano Model, MoSCoW, and Cost of Delay
Outcome-based roadmapping vs output-based feature lists
Defining North Star Metrics, leading indicators, and lagging indicators
stages.project: Author an executive-ready PRD and 6-month roadmap for an innovative AI-assisted workplace productivity tool.

stages.title: Stage 3: Agile Execution & Cross-Functional Collaboration
stages.summary: Partner with engineering and UX design teams to ship high-quality product increments predictably.
topics: Scrum & Kanban rituals: sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily standups, retrospectives
Managing engineering trade-offs: technical debt vs new feature velocity
Working effectively with UX designers on wireframes and rapid prototypes
Release planning, beta testing cohorts, and feature flag rollouts
stages.project: Manage a simulated multi-week sprint with developer estimations, scope adjustments, and sprint review demo.

stages.title: Stage 4: Product Analytics & Experimentation
stages.summary: Leverage quantitative product data, funnel analyses, and A/B split testing to drive continuous growth.
topics: Event tracking taxonomy planning and user journey funnels
Cohort analysis, retention curves, and churn diagnostics
Designing statistically sound A/B split tests and sample size calculations
Product-Led Growth (PLG) mechanics: self-serve onboarding and time-to-value (TTV)
stages.project: Analyze an onboarding drop-off dataset, formulate an optimization hypothesis, and design a full A/B test experiment.

stages.title: Stage 5: Go-to-Market, Monetization & AI Products
stages.summary: Lead successful product launches, formulate pricing tiers, and manage generative AI products.
topics: Go-to-Market (GTM) launch tiers, customer enablement, and marketing alignment
SaaS pricing and packaging models: freemium, usage-based, tiered seat licensing
Product management for AI: evaluating hallucinations, UX for uncertainty, latency expectations
Executive stakeholder management and board deck presentations
stages.project: Build a comprehensive GTM Launch & Pricing Strategy package for a new enterprise software offering.

roadmaps.title: Growth & Performance Marketer
roadmaps.description: Scale revenue through full-funnel customer acquisition, paid performance ads, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), lifecycle retention, and data-driven growth experimentation.

stages.title: Stage 1: Growth Marketing Fundamentals & Copywriting
stages.summary: Understand full-funnel acquisition (AARRR), consumer psychology, and conversion-focused copywriting.
topics: The Pirate Funnel: Acquisition, Activation, Retention, Referral, Revenue (AARRR)
Direct-response copywriting: headlines, emotional hooks, value props, and calls to action
Buyer journey stages: Unaware, Problem Aware, Solution Aware, Product Aware, Most Aware
Designing conversion-optimized landing pages with clear hierarchy
stages.project: Draft complete multi-stage copy and design a high-converting landing page for a B2B SaaS product.

stages.title: Stage 2: Paid Acquisition & Performance Advertising
stages.summary: Master paid advertising on Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and LinkedIn Ads with high ROAS.
topics: Google Ads: search intent campaigns, negative keywords, Quality Score, and Performance Max
Meta Ads Manager: custom audiences, lookalike modeling, dynamic creative testing
LinkedIn B2B targeting: account-based marketing (ABM) and matched audiences
Budget pacing, bidding strategies (tCPA, tROAS), and creative fatigue management
stages.project: Build and execute an omnichannel ad campaign structure with tailored creative sets and audience exclusions.

stages.title: Stage 3: SEO & Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
stages.summary: Drive compound organic traffic through technical SEO, topic clusters, and AI search visibility.
topics: Keyword research: search volume, intent classification, and competitor keyword gaps
Technical SEO: site speed, crawl budget, canonical tags, and structured schema markup
Topic clusters, pillar pages, and programmatic SEO scaling
Answer Engine Optimization (AEO): optimizing content for LLM citations (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini)
stages.project: Perform a comprehensive technical SEO audit of a live website, fixing indexing errors and creating a 20-topic cluster plan.

stages.title: Stage 4: Analytics, Attribution & Data Infrastructure
stages.summary: Implement tracking tags, measure true channel ROI, and build executive performance dashboards.
topics: Google Analytics 4 (GA4) custom event tracking and conversion setup
Google Tag Manager (GTM): triggers, variables, and server-side tagging (CAPI)
Attribution modeling: first-touch, last-touch, multi-touch, and incrementality testing
Building automated marketing dashboards in Looker Studio connecting ad platforms
stages.project: Implement end-to-end event tracking on an e-commerce site via GTM and build an automated live ROAS dashboard.

stages.title: Stage 5: Lifecycle Marketing, Retention & Viral Loops
stages.summary: Nurture leads into loyal customers with automated email journeys, SMS, and viral referral loops.
topics: Automated email sequences: welcome drips, abandoned cart recovery, post-purchase onboarding
Audience segmentation, RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) analysis, and churn prediction
Email deliverability optimization: SPF, DKIM, DMARC records, and inbox placement
Viral referral programs and product-led growth invitation loops
stages.project: Design and implement a 7-stage automated customer lifecycle retention engine with dynamic personalization.

roadmaps.title: Health Informatics & Clinical Data Specialist
roadmaps.description: Bridge healthcare delivery and digital systems: EHR optimization, FHIR interoperability, clinical decision support (CDS), healthcare privacy (HIPAA), and clinical outcome analytics.
prerequisites: Understanding of healthcare terminology or general science background

stages.title: Stage 1: Healthcare Systems, Terminology & Regulations
stages.summary: Understand healthcare workflows, clinical terminology, and health data regulatory privacy laws.
topics: Clinical workflows: inpatient admissions, outpatient clinics, triage, and pharmacy dispensing
Standard clinical coding systems: ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS, SNOMED-CT, and LOINC
HIPAA compliance, patient privacy rights, and Protected Health Information (PHI) safeguards
Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems architecture (Epic, Cerner, MEDITECH)
stages.project: Map an entire patient clinical journey from emergency intake through post-discharge billing with accurate ICD-10 and CPT coding.

stages.title: Stage 2: Health Data Standards & FHIR Interoperability
stages.summary: Master healthcare interoperability standards including HL7 v2 messaging and modern RESTful FHIR APIs.
topics: HL7 v2 message parsing (ADT, ORU, MDM segments) and interface engines
HL7 FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources) REST APIs and JSON schemas
SMART on FHIR application authentication (OAuth2 for EHRs)
DICOM standard for diagnostic medical imaging storage and PACS integration
stages.project: Build an interface engine pipeline that translates legacy HL7 v2 admission messages into standardized FHIR Patient resources.

stages.title: Stage 3: Clinical Data Warehousing & SQL Analytics
stages.summary: Extract, transform, and analyze clinical patient cohorts using SQL and observational health models.
topics: Clinical data warehousing models: OMOP Common Data Model (OHDSI) and PCORnet
Writing complex SQL queries across millions of patient encounters and lab results
Analyzing clinical cohorts in de-identified datasets (MIMIC-IV, Synthea)
Handling missing laboratory values, temporal time-series, and survival analysis
stages.project: Conduct a retrospective cohort study on MIMIC-IV patient data investigating 30-day readmission risk factors.

stages.title: Stage 4: Clinical Quality Dashboards & Healthcare BI
stages.summary: Design interactive visual intelligence dashboards monitoring patient safety and hospital metrics.
topics: Hospital quality measures: HEDIS, CMS Star Ratings, and Joint Commission core metrics
Designing executive clinical dashboards tracking bed occupancy, ED wait times, and infection rates
Data storytelling for healthcare executives and chief medical officers
Automated alert thresholds for sepsis detection and patient deterioration
stages.project: Build an interactive hospital operational dashboard displaying emergency department wait times, readmission trends, and bed capacity.

stages.title: Stage 5: Clinical AI Validation & Healthcare Innovation
stages.summary: Validate clinical AI models, prevent algorithmic bias, and ensure FDA SaMD compliance.
topics: Clinical decision support (CDS) integration within provider EHR workflows
Validating predictive algorithms for readmission, sepsis, and radiological diagnosis
Auditing clinical algorithms for demographic bias and calibration drift
FDA regulations for Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) and Good Machine Learning Practice (GMLP)
stages.project: Validate an open-source clinical sepsis risk prediction model, assess calibration curves, and design an alert integration plan.

roadmaps.title: Smart Manufacturing & Industry 4.0 Engineer
roadmaps.description: Digitize industrial factory operations: PLC/SCADA automation, Industrial IoT connectivity (OPC-UA/MQTT), Digital Twins, predictive maintenance, and manufacturing execution systems (MES).
prerequisites: Basic understanding of manufacturing processes or electrical circuits

stages.title: Stage 1: Industrial Automation & PLC Programming
stages.summary: Learn industrial control principles, sensor wiring, and ladder logic programming for industrial PLCs.
topics: Industrial hardware: sensors, relays, contactors, VFDs (Variable Frequency Drives), and pneumatic actuators
IEC 61131-3 programming languages: Ladder Logic (LD), Structured Text (ST), Function Block Diagram (FBD)
Safety interlocks, emergency stop circuits, and machinery safety standards (ISO 13849)
Wiring and testing industrial 24V DC control panels
stages.project: Program a complete automated sorting and packaging conveyor line with emergency safety interlocks in Structured Text.

stages.title: Stage 2: SCADA, HMI & Industrial Protocols
stages.summary: Design operator human-machine interfaces (HMI) and configure industrial fieldbus networks.
topics: High-performance HMI design adhering to ISA-101 situational awareness standards
Industrial communication protocols: Modbus TCP/RTU, Profinet, EtherNet/IP
SCADA architecture: alarms, real-time tag databases, and historical trending
Configuring industrial managed network switches and VLAN segmentation
stages.project: Build a comprehensive plant SCADA supervisory dashboard in Ignition with real-time tank level alarms and trend logging.

stages.title: Stage 3: Industrial IoT, Unified Namespace & MQTT
stages.summary: Build an event-driven Industry 4.0 data architecture connecting shop-floor sensors to enterprise clouds.
topics: Unified Namespace (UNS) architecture and the Purdue Model transformation
MQTT and Sparkplug B specification for standardized industrial payloads
OPC-UA server and client configurations for multi-vendor machine interoperability
Edge computing gateways: deploying Docker containers on industrial Linux gateways
stages.project: Create an edge gateway pipeline collecting vibration and temperature telemetry over Modbus and publishing to a central MQTT UNS.

stages.title: Stage 4: Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) & OEE
stages.summary: Track shop-floor productivity, downtime Pareto analysis, and overall equipment effectiveness (OEE).
topics: Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE) calculations: Availability × Performance × Quality
Digital work instructions and electronic batch recording (eBR)
Track-and-trace lot genealogy and automated scrap reporting
Integrating MES layers with enterprise ERP systems (SAP S/4HANA)
stages.project: Implement an automated OEE calculation system tracking live machine states and calculating operator shift productivity.

stages.title: Stage 5: Digital Twins, Predictive Maintenance & Cyber Security
stages.summary: Deploy AI predictive maintenance models, simulate factory layouts in digital twins, and secure OT networks.
topics: Predictive maintenance: vibration spectral analysis, motor current signature analysis (MCSA), and anomaly detection
Building 3D digital twins of production lines using physics simulation platforms
Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity following IEC 62443 standards
Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) and Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs) integration
stages.project: Develop a predictive maintenance pipeline analyzing real-time accelerometer streams to forecast bearing failure 48 hours in advance.

roadmaps.title: BIM & Virtual Design Construction Specialist
roadmaps.description: Coordinate digital architecture and structural engineering: 3D Revit modeling, multi-trade clash detection, 4D schedule sequencing, 5D cost take-offs, and laser scan point clouds.

stages.title: Stage 1: Architectural Drawing & Parametric 3D Modeling
stages.summary: Master parametric building modeling in Autodesk Revit following architectural standards.
topics: Building components: walls, slabs, curtain systems, roofs, and parametric families
Structural framing: columns, beams, foundations, and reinforcement rebar
Construction documentation: floor plans, sections, elevations, and detail callouts
BIM Project setup: shared coordinates, datum levels, grids, and worksharing
stages.project: Model a complete commercial two-story building in Autodesk Revit with coordinated architectural plans and schedules.

stages.title: Stage 2: MEP Systems & LOD Standards
stages.summary: Model Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) systems according to Level of Development (LOD) standards.
topics: HVAC ductwork sizing, routing, air terminals, and mechanical equipment
Electrical cable trays, conduit runs, panelboards, and lighting fixtures
Plumbing domestic water, sanitary drainage, and fire protection sprinkler systems
BIMForum Level of Development (LOD 100 to 500) specification requirements
stages.project: Design fully routed, sloped sanitary plumbing and coordinated HVAC ductwork for an office floorplate at LOD 350.

stages.title: Stage 3: Clash Detection & Multi-Trade Coordination
stages.summary: Federate multi-trade models and execute automated clash detection tests in Navisworks Manage.
topics: Importing IFC, DWG, and NWD files into federated coordination models
Configuring Clash Detective rule sets (hard clashes, soft clearances, tolerances)
Grouping, assigning, and tracking clash resolution issues using BCF (BIM Collaboration Format)
Facilitating trade coordination meetings with subcontractors
stages.project: Perform clash detection between structural steel and MEP services on a complex hospital floor, resolving 100+ interferences.

stages.title: Stage 4: 4D Time Scheduling & 5D Cost Estimation
stages.summary: Link BIM elements with project schedules for 4D visual simulations and extract automated 5D cost takeoffs.
topics: Linking construction schedules (Primavera P6, MS Project) with 3D geometry in Navisworks / Synchro
Creating 4D visual construction sequence simulations and crane logistics models
Automated QTO (Quantity Take-Off) and material cost estimations from model parameters
5D cost modeling and cash-flow forecasting throughout the project lifecycle
stages.project: Produce an animated 4D construction simulation video showing monthly foundation-to-envelope sequence paired with material cost curves.

stages.title: Stage 5: Reality Capture, Laser Scanning & Field BIM
stages.summary: Integrate terrestrial 3D laser scan point clouds, drone photogrammetry, and field mobile BIM tools.
topics: Terrestrial 3D laser scanning (LiDAR) and point cloud registration
Scan-to-BIM modeling and as-built deviation analysis against design models
Drone photogrammetry for earthwork volumetric calculations and jobsite progress
Field BIM on mobile tablets (Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud) for QA/QC punch lists
stages.project: Register a multi-station 3D laser scan of a concrete floor slab and perform as-built heat map deviation analysis against the BIM model.

roadmaps.title: Data Scientist & ML Engineer
roadmaps.description: Transform raw data into predictive intelligence: statistical hypothesis testing, feature engineering, tree-based models (XGBoost), deep learning (PyTorch), and production MLOps deployment.

stages.title: Stage 1: Python, Exploratory Data Analysis & Statistics
stages.summary: Master Pandas, NumPy data manipulation, hypothesis testing (t-tests, ANOVA), and visualization with Seaborn/Plotly.
topics: Data wrangling with Pandas: indexing, grouping, pivoting, and handling missing data
Statistical inference: central limit theorem, p-values, confidence intervals, and hypothesis tests
Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) and data visualization with Seaborn and Plotly
Feature scaling, one-hot encoding, and numerical transformations
stages.project: Perform an in-depth exploratory analysis on a real-world customer churn dataset with interactive Plotly visual charts.

stages.title: Stage 2: Classical Machine Learning & Feature Engineering
stages.summary: Train and optimize supervised regression, classification, and unsupervised clustering algorithms.
topics: Linear and Logistic regression, regularization (L1 Lasso, L2 Ridge)
Decision trees, Random Forests, Gradient Boosted Trees (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost)
Unsupervised learning: K-Means clustering, hierarchical clustering, and PCA dimensionality reduction
Cross-validation strategies, hyperparameter tuning with Optuna, and ROC-AUC metrics
stages.project: Build a credit card fraud detection system with imbalanced data handling (SMOTE) and XGBoost achieving 98% recall.

stages.title: Stage 3: Deep Learning, PyTorch & Neural Networks
stages.summary: Build and train deep neural networks for computer vision and natural language processing tasks.
topics: PyTorch neural network architectures, custom loss functions, and optimizers (AdamW)
Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and vision transfer learning (ResNet, EfficientNet)
Recurrent networks (LSTMs) and sequence models for time-series forecasting
Transformer self-attention mechanisms and pre-trained Hugging Face models
stages.project: Train a medical chest X-ray disease classification model in PyTorch using transfer learning and grad-CAM interpretability.

stages.title: Stage 4: MLOps, Tracking & Production Model Serving
stages.summary: Track model experiments, maintain feature stores, and deploy low-latency inference APIs.
topics: Experiment tracking and model registry with MLflow or Weights & Biases
Packaging models into containerized REST APIs using FastAPI and Docker
Feature stores (Feast) and data validation checks with Great Expectations
Model quantization, ONNX runtime conversion, and batch prediction jobs
stages.project: Package an ensemble prediction model into a Dockerized FastAPI service with automated MLflow versioning.

stages.title: Stage 5: Live Monitoring, Concept Drift & Business Impact
stages.summary: Monitor production model drift, manage A/B test experiments, and quantify commercial impact.
topics: Monitoring data drift, prediction drift, and concept drift using EvidentlyAI
Designing online A/B test experiments and evaluating statistical lift
Interpretable AI: SHAP (Shapley Additive exPlanations) and LIME feature importance
Communicating findings and business ROI to executive stakeholders
stages.project: Deploy a live monitoring dashboard tracking model accuracy drift and alerting engineering when retraining is required.

roadmaps.title: Mobile App Developer (Flutter & Cross-Platform)
roadmaps.description: Build polished, native-performance iOS and Android applications using Flutter and Dart: state management, camera/GPS hardware APIs, offline persistence, and App Store publication.

stages.title: Stage 1: Dart Programming & UI Layout Engine
stages.summary: Master Dart object-oriented programming, async streams, and the Flutter widget tree.
topics: Dart language: sound null safety, classes, mixins, streams, and async/await
Flutter core architecture: everything is a widget (Stateless vs Stateful)
Layout widgets: Row, Column, Stack, Flex, Container, and MediaQuery
Designing Material 3 and Cupertino native UI interfaces
stages.project: Build a beautiful, responsive crypto currency tracking app with custom animated chart cards.

stages.title: Stage 2: State Management & Navigation Routing
stages.summary: Implement predictable state management using Riverpod or Bloc and declarative deep-linking routing.
topics: State management paradigms: Provider, Riverpod, and BLoC (Business Logic Component)
Declarative navigation with go_router and deep linking across iOS and Android
Forms validation, custom controllers, and error handling
Custom theme switching (Dark & Light modes) with persistent user preferences
stages.project: Create a multi-screen recipe discovery app with dynamic search, bookmarks state, and persistent dark mode.

stages.title: Stage 3: REST APIs, Caching & Local Storage
stages.summary: Fetch backend data, implement offline caching with Hive/SQLite, and serialize JSON data safely.
topics: HTTP networking with Dio: interceptors, retries, and token authentication headers
JSON serialization using build_runner and json_serializable
Local offline caching using Hive, Isar, or sqflite
Offline-first synchronization patterns and optimistic UI updates
stages.project: Build an offline-first fitness logging mobile app that caches workouts locally and syncs with cloud endpoints on reconnect.

stages.title: Stage 4: Hardware Sensors, Camera & Push Notifications
stages.summary: Interface native device hardware: camera, GPS geolocation, biometric authentication, and push notifications.
topics: Capturing photos and video with native camera APIs and image cropping
GPS location tracking and interactive Google Maps integration
Biometric face/fingerprint authentication with local_auth
Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) for background and foreground push notifications
stages.project: Develop a social geotagging app where users snap photos, tag exact GPS coordinates, and receive nearby alert push notifications.

stages.title: Stage 5: Testing, CI/CD & App Store Deployment
stages.summary: Automate unit and widget testing, configure Fastlane build scripts, and publish to Apple App Store and Google Play.
topics: Unit testing business logic and widget testing with WidgetTester
Integration testing end-to-end user flows on emulators and real physical devices
Automating app signing and build distribution with Fastlane
App Store Connect and Google Play Console release management, screenshot assets, and compliance
stages.project: Configure an automated GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline that runs tests, signs release builds, and uploads artifacts to TestFlight.
